title: AssetSpec
description: Single shared spec that drives the Three.js preview, the Blender builder, and the auto-generated UI controls.

asset_type.description: Builder key, e.g. street_light, pedestrian_lamp, bench, bollard, traffic_sign, trash_bin, planter, hydrant.

units.description: Display units for the UI. Individual parameters carry their own unit.

code_mode.description: strict = clamp values to US-code ranges; advisory = warn only (movie/animation props).

options.description: Only for type=select (e.g. lantern style: acorn, teardrop, modern).

code_ref.description: Key or citation into /standards/us_codes.json, e.g. AASHTO-RDG-lighting, MUTCD-2A.18.

uv_scale.description: Texture tiling density; applied to procedural surface detail in the preview and to texture mapping in Blender.

primitives.description: Custom parametric geometry for asset types without a curated builder ('generate anything' path). All dimensions are METERS, +Z up, asset grounded at z=0. Numeric fields accept expressions over parameter/toggle ids, e.g. 'seat_height + 0.02' (allowed: numbers, ids, + - * / parentheses, min(), max(), abs(); toggles evaluate to 0 or 1).

kind.description: lathe: revolve a profile around Z (lantern globes, finials, domes, planters). sweep: round tube following a 3D path with optional taper (mast arms, handrails, pipe runs). loft: taper between two cross-sections (cobra heads, flared transitions). tube: hollow cylinder with wall thickness (real poles/bollards are not solid).

visible_if.description: Expression; primitive is skipped when it evaluates to 0 (use toggle ids).

cut.description: Negative space: this primitive is boolean-SUBTRACTED from the other parts of its component (bolt holes, slots, cutouts) instead of being rendered.

array.description: Linear repetition: expands this primitive into `count` copies offset by `step` each (fence pickets, slats, bolt rows).

segments.description: Radial segments for cylinders/cones (default 24; use 6 for hex bolt heads and nuts).

shell.description: Wall thickness in meters: turns the part into hollow sheet/cast construction (luminaire housings, bins, shades). Applied as a solidify pass in Blender.

profile.description: For kind=lathe: a named profile (acorn, teardrop, dome, finial, flared_base, vase — scaled by radius+depth) or a raw [[r,z],...] point list in meters, z from 0 (bottom, at the primitive's location) upward.

path.description: For kind=sweep: 3D points (relative to location, meters) the tube follows.

radius_end.description: For kind=sweep: tip radius (tapers from radius to radius_end along the path).

wall.description: For kind=tube: wall thickness in meters.

profile_start.description: For kind=loft: cross-section at -depth/2 along local Z.

profile_end.description: For kind=loft: cross-section at +depth/2 along local Z.

offsets.description: Per-component ('pole') or per-part ('pole/shaft') position nudges in meters, applied after building. Component and part offsets stack. Lets users reposition individual parts in the editor; honored identically by the Blender export.

components.description: Named component hierarchy; exported as nested DAE nodes so SketchUp imports editable sub-components.

seed.description: Deterministic seed for organic detail (weathering, UV offsets).
